question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words/phrase.**

A formal agreement between the belligerents to momentarily stop the active hostilities
solution:
The correct answer is-** '​Armistice​'**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us see the meanings of the given options:
 
 
• **Armistice: **an agreement between two countries who are at war that they will stop fighting. (युद्घ के बीच कुछ समय तक लड़ाई न करने की संधि; युद्घविराम)

 
 
• **Example: ***A two-week **armistice** has been declared between the rival factions.*
 
 
 
• **Artisan: **a person who makes things skilfully, especially with his/her hands. (कारीगर, शिल्पकार)
 
• **Artillery: **large, heavy guns that are moved on wheels; the part of the army that uses them. (तोपख़ाना; तोपची सैन्‍य दल)
 
• **Arteries: **tubes that take blood from the heart to other parts of the body. (हृदय से शरीर के अन्‍य भागों में रक्त ले जाने वाली नली; धमनी)
 
 
 
• Therefore, a formal agreement between the belligerents to momentarily stop the active hostilities is called **"Armistice."***​*
